title: Excellent expierence
text: Excellent experience, really enjoyable our guide Ricardo was excellent and really friendly. He provided us with lots of stories about the history surrounding the river and the monuments, also some local knowledge. Couldn't recommend highly enough, and lastly the views were incredible.
author: danielbU1952QS

title: Amazing!
text: This was a definite highlight of our trip to Seville! Our instructors, Pablo and Juan, were both fantastic, and the experience was absolutely worth it. I recommend anyone visiting Seville to try the sunset kayaking ☺️
